regions: A drag that starts outside the map (east, south, west black) makes no region.

A drag from inside that runs out of the map stops at the last point inside: east 3968 and 4000, west -3744, south -3872, north 3392 on a map of x, y -4096 to 4096 (the last motion step, so it varies).
